analysis.title: EMEA UCITS ETP Flow Update, 02 November 2026
key_insights: Total UCITS ETP inflows were $9.3B in the week of 22-28 Oct 2026, down from $10.2B the prior week. Equity ETPs took $6.7B (up from $5.9B), fixed income $2.6B (down from $3.5B), and commodities reversed to a net outflow of -$42m after $855m of inflows.

Developed market equity ETPs gathered $6.2B (prior $5.5B). North America led at $3.0B (prior $519m), global DM took $2.8B (prior $3.9B), European inflows halved to $523m from $1B, and APAC reversed to -$70m from $196m.

At the country level the US took $2.9B (prior $562m), Switzerland $161m, Japan $117m (prior $169m) and the UK $81m. Germany had the largest outflow at -$52m. Within US size exposures, Large Caps took $1.3B (prior $496m), Mid Caps -$92m and Small Caps -$45m.

Emerging market equity ETPs attracted $556m (prior $313m). Broad EM took $322m and single-country products $177m after -$69m the prior week. Brazil took $162m (prior $25m), South Korea $43m (prior $340m), and China saw outflows ease to -$136m from -$411m.
Active equity ETPs took $714m (prior $665m). Alpha-Seeking took $506m, Outcome $214m (prior $129m, mostly Dividend at $205m) and Exposure -$7m.

Sustainable equity ETPs took $731m after $62m the prior week. North America reversed to +$276m from -$399m, and screened strategies took $561m (prior $7m). Optimised (-$143m) and Tilt (-$74m) strategies kept seeing outflows.

Sector ETPs saw -$101m (prior -$52m) and thematics reversed to -$219m from +$134m. Health Care led sector inflows at $403m and Technology took $227m, while Financials had -$398m and Consumer Discretionary -$156m. Thematic selling was led by Natural Resources (-$99m) and Robotics & AI (-$45m, after +$161m the prior week).

Income strategies took $631m (prior $349m) and Factors $379m. Low Volatility took $440m (prior $216m) while Value had -$164m (prior -$291m) and Quality slowed to $36m from $329m. Alternatives took $30m (prior $159m).
Commodity ETPs had -$42m after $855m. Gold took $98m (prior $704m), Silver $20m, Oil $12m, and Other Commodities had -$172m.

Fixed income ETPs took $2.6B (prior $3.5B), with indexed strategies at $2.5B. Investment Grade took $1.2B, ahead of Government at $823m (prior $1.5B), and High Yield took $430m (prior $259m). Inflation-linked reversed to -$158m. USD Government inflows slowed to $196m from $1.4B.
Active fixed income ETPs took $142m (prior $449m). Indexed sustainable fixed income reversed to -$137m from +$87m.
UCITS ETP dollar average daily volume was $22.0B (1.1x the 3-month average). Equity $ADV was $16.4B, fixed income $4.9B and commodities $0.7B (0.7x the 3-month average).

sector_views.rationale: Led sector ETP inflows at $403m, up from $140m the prior week. This is a flow observation, not a bank view.
Sector ETP inflows of $227m, more than double the prior $103m. This is a flow observation, not a bank view.
Largest sector outflow at -$398m after -$373m the prior week. This is a flow observation, not a bank view.

risk_factors: Financials ETPs had the largest sector outflow at -$398m, and European sector ETPs had -$309m.
Robotics & AI thematic ETPs reversed to -$45m from +$161m, with Cloud Computing at -$41m and Artificial Intelligence at -$30m at the sub-theme level.
Gold ETP inflows slowed to $98m from $704m, and Other Commodities outflows deepened to -$172m.
vol_and_positioning: Low Volatility factor ETPs took $440m, more than double the prior $216m, with $247m into Global and $177m into North American strategies.
Value factor ETPs had -$164m, easing from -$291m. Value-Global was -$125m and Value-Europe -$34m.
Quality factor inflows fell to $36m from $329m.
Outcome active equity ETPs took $214m (prior $129m), with $205m in Dividend strategies. US Buffer took $1m.
UCITS ETP dollar average daily volume was $22.0B (1.1x the 3-month average). Commodities ran at 0.7x.
